metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from webhejj. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this one only lists them.

plugins.name: awt
plugins.description: Work with a wikilinked markdown wiki through the agent-wiki-toolbox: the link graph, structural edits that keep it intact, formatting, and the guard that routes wiki work through the skill.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Keep and use an atlas catalog: the entry schemas an atlas repo validates against, the atlas command line, and a session-start hook that says what the catalog has at the session's directory.

plugins.name: duckdb-skills
plugins.description: A fork of DuckDB's own duckdb-skills plugin with bug fixes: read any data file, attach and query DuckDB databases, search DuckDB and DuckLake docs, and install DuckDB extensions.
